Tap Undo in the message at the bottom of the screen. It stays for 6 seconds. If you do something else first, Undo switches to that newer action.

q: How do I move a card?
a: Drag the six dots in the card’s corner. On a keyboard, focus the dots and press the arrow keys. The Inbox always stays first.

q: Can I add my own lists?
a: Yes. The last card on the board adds one: type a name, pick a color and press Add category. Tap any card’s title to rename it.

q: What if my Sub Club ends?
a: Your board is kept exactly as it is. It’s there again when you come back.
